notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Exciting news! Parkour Tag is ready to go and the early access will be launching [b]November 1st 2021[/b]. Spread the news to all your parkour loving friends and make sure to add the game to your wishlist!

[previewyoutube=L1H-F3VQOqE;full][/previewyoutube]

See you then!
